capabilities: Chat with Google Gemini including file attachments, voice, and web search
Let the AI read, edit, and organize vault notes with confirmation dialogs
Automate multi-step tasks with a visual workflow builder and 24 node types
Search the vault with RAG via Google File Search
Extend the AI with agent skills, MCP servers, and OKF knowledge sources
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Free with a free Gemini API key, but image generation and some models require a paid API key; web search via Gemini may incur notable per-query costs. Since v1.11.0 the plugin is Gemini-only; CLI and multi-LLM support moved to the separate obsidian-llm-hub plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI features, so tasks like chatting over notes, semantic vault search, and multi-step AI automation require a Gemini integration.

relations.evidence: Built-in skills - Obsidian-specific knowledge (Markdown, Canvas, Bases) included out of the box. Based on kepano/obsidian-skills
When both plugins are enabled, Gemini Helper supplies Dashboard Hub with its configured Gemini models, Chat handoff, Base generation
Gemini Helper automatically registers its available non-image Gemini models with Discussion Hub
Install speech-popup and a microphone button appears above the send button
A new plugin obsidian-llm-hub has been created with CLI and multiple LLM provider support (OpenAI, Claude, OpenRouter, Local LLM)

requires.name: Tavily or Brave Search API key for external web search
Dashboard Hub and Discussion Hub for their integrations

summary: AI assistant powered by Google Gemini with chat, vault operations, workflow automation, RAG search, agent skills, and MCP tool support.
